text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (July 2, 2024) for 83 Clearview Heights

The Property Standards Committee - Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (July 2, 2024) for 83 Clearview Heights, Folder Number 24 172925 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension of time to March 31, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
